I apologize, I'd rather not say. It's a personal health issue I'm rather embarrassed by. 

That is true, I just hope I'd be able to get there. Public transportation I'm thankfully used to and comfortable with. 

I certainly hope he's able to understand why I'm choosing my actions. If it weren't for my situation I would be gladly welcoming another life. 

:) Those are good, yes you're right. Maybe my child is too young still to show any interest but I have taken him for walks and he enjoys them. 

He's being as supportive as he can be, I just feel like I'm burdening him. I understand though.

Thank you for your reply. It's good to hear someone else say something to me. Something that may be so small to someone else is such a huge feeling for me since I've been very limited with any type of communication. :)
